why: v138 actual public permission needs a protected EnrolledPublicWebScope; no active table/producer existed. This defines configuration selection, not per-input egress authority.
source: Actual components/plugin_public_https.py PublicReadTarget and EnrolledPublicWebScope; no inferred native tool or host permission.

field_rules.identities: Nonempty exact protected IDs; generation is selected process/profile generation, not package generation. Unique enrollment_id; rows sorted enrollment_id. No row contains enclosing service_generation_digest.

targets.hostname: Canonical lower-case public DNS; no trailing dot, local/internal/localhost or IP selector
targets.path_prefixes: Sorted unique nonempty list, each absolute / prefix <=512 chars, no backslash or traversal; no URL/path wildcard interpretation
targets.query_keys: Sorted unique keys <=64 chars; no credential/token/authorization/session/secret names; actual handler sensitive-query deny applies

field_rules.source_fields: Exact current root registry observation handles and lower64 SHA; target contract artifact receipt is actual reviewed installed source/config schema, not website content or caller JSON.

producer.owner: native target configuration + factory + active publisher
producer.source: RootNativeComponentTargetRegistry actual root TTY normal configuration under v137, installed release/controller/current principal and namespace selectors. Explicit public hostname/path/query selections start blank; source-owned canonical configuration schema validates exact existing PublicReadTarget shape. No arbitrary caller-provided scope record.
producer.target_selection: Actual RootPreparedNativeTargetSelection supplies target_selection_handle, configuration_observation_handle/configuration_sha256 and source target-contract receipt. Root registry retains canonical scope payload and configuration/source choice membership; configuration choice is intent, not granted egress.
producer.publication: Root active compiler projects exact registry-resolved scope payload plus source foreign keys into public_web_scopes in the same atomic policy selection as web action/effect rows. Publisher verifies current selection/source/profile/principal/namespace and target observation before signing. It never requires already active public_web_scopes for first compilation.
producer.joins: For web retrieve effect: enrollment_id equals exact NativeActionRecord.effect_enrollment_id; target equals plugin:web:<target_id>:<generation>, operation plugin.web.read, selected profile/principal/generation/recipient match exact effect binding. SourceIssuerRecord.public_web_scope_ids identifies exact enrollment_id values. Every referenced scope must resolve, no broad matching by profile/action name.
producer.scope_payload_sha256: SHA256 UTF8 canonical JSON over exactly first ten row fields (sort_keys=true,separators comma/colon,ensure_ascii=false), excluding source handles and enclosing snapshot digest. Source configuration observation retains these exact bytes or exact named scope member; never substitute generic source document digest.

runtime.dto: Exact ten payload fields plus source foreign keys, scope_payload_sha256 and verified enclosing service_generation_digest; registry/current snapshot sealed. DTO reconstructs existing EnrolledPublicWebScope only after all source/effect joins. Getter rechecks current active publication and genuine retained selection provenance; absence or conflicting source is unavailable.
runtime.permission: v138 per-input PUBLIC observation and current RootPublicInputPermission still mandatory every dispatch/retry. Scope does not classify input, grant private egress, authorize writes, providers, memory export, or additional metered budget. PRIVATE/UNKNOWN ancestry denied; all parent ceilings intersect.

Strict active table/getter and PUBLIC per-input permission join; missing/conflicting source, PRIVATE ancestry, stale selection and out-of-scope URLs deny.
